figures.figure_caption:
Figure 1. Rare WFS1 variants in CHH: genetic identification and structural-dynamical modeling

(A) Family tree of WFS1 affected probands in family I and family II. Black square and a black circle represent affected individuals. (B-C) PolyPhen2 prediction of the effect of Cys426Tyr (B) and Leu432Val (C) on WFS1. Cys426Tyr is predicted to be benign, while Leu432Val is predicted to be damaging. (D-E) 3D models obtained by AlphaFold of WFS1 in monomeric (D) and tetrameric (E) form.

(F-G) Delta stability caused by the introduction of the Cys426Tyr and Leu432Val mutations in frames extracted from MD simulations of the monomer (F) and tetramer (G) of WFS1. (H) PC1 vs PC2 plots of each chain of wild-type (top) and Cys426Tyr (bottom) tetrameric WFS1. Each dot represents a residue. (I-J) DCCM plot for tetrameric WFS1 wild-type (I) and Cys426Tyr (J).
figures.caption_title: Figure 1. Rare WFS1 variants in CHH: genetic identification and structural-dynamical modeling

figures.figure_caption:
Figure 2. WFS1 variants induce ER stress and UPR.

Confocal images of COS7 cell line stained with Anti-Wfs1 antibody (green), concanavalin A (red) and merge in NT (A-A’’), WFS1 WT (B-B’’), WFS1 C426Y (p. Cys426Tyr) (C-C’’), WFS1 L432V (p.Leu432Val) (D-D’’) and WFS1 P724L (p. Pro724Leu) (E-E’’). Scale bar: 20 μm. Representative images from three independent biological experiments are shown. (F) Western blotting representative image of WFS1 and ACTB in COS7 cell line transfected with WT vector, WFS1 variants (C426Y and L432V), P724L internal control and NT (not transfected). (F’) Western blotting quantification and normalization with actin. ONE Way ANOVA with Dunnett post hoc correction. *p<0.05; ***p<0.001; ****p<0.0001; exact p values are provided in Appendix Table S1. Results are expressed as means ± standard error of the mean (SEM) from three independent biological experiments. (G) qPCR of WFS1 in COS7 cell line transfected with WT, C426Y, L432V and P724L. ONE Way ANOVA with Dunnett post hoc correction. ns (non-significant). Results are expressed as means ± standard error of the mean (SEM) from three independent biological experiments, with three technical replicates per biological replicate. (H) Luciferase reporter assay reveals ER stress in COS7 cell line transfected with WT, C426Y, L432V and P724L and NT. ONE Way ANOVA with Dunnett post hoc correction. *p<0.05; ****p<0.0001; exact p values are provided in Appendix Table S1. Results are expressed as means ± standard error of the mean (SEM) from three independent biological experiments, with six technical replicates per biological replicate. (I-O) qPCR analyses of unfolded protein response markers in COS7 cell line transfected with WT vector, WFS1 mutations (C426Y and L432V), P724L and NT. ONE Way ANOVA with Dunnet post hoc correction. *p<0.05; **p<0.01; ***p<0.001; ****p<0.0001; ns (non-significant); exact p values are provided in Appendix Table S1. Results are expressed as means ± standard error of the mean (SEM) from three independent biological experiments, with three technical replicates per biological replicate.
figures.caption_title: Figure 2. WFS1 variants induce ER stress and UPR.

figures.figure_caption:
Figure 3. WFS1 expression in GnRH-related regions.

(A) Schematic representation of gnrh3 (green) and wfs1 (red) expression in zebrafish embryos at 48 hpf. Colocalization of gnrh3 and wfs1 is highlighted in yellow. The dotted square indicates the area shown at higher magnification in panels (B–D).

(B–D) Immunostaining of wfs1 in wild-type Tg (GnRH3: EGFP) embryos at 48hpf. Images were acquired in ventral view. Scale bar: 100 μm. Abbreviations: olfactory bulbs (OBs), anterior commissure (AC), preoptic area (POA), hypothalamus (Hy). Representative images from three independent biological experiments are shown. (E-N) Fluorescent in situ hybridization (FISH) for Wfs1 transcript (red) followed by immunostaining for nTubb3 (green) on coronal section from mouse embryonic head at E14.5 at the level of the nose. White dotted boxes indicate area shown at higher magnification in (I-K) and (L-N). White arrows indicate expression of Wfs1 in neurogenic epithelia of the nose (VNO and OE). Single or combination of channel images are shown beside corresponding panels. Sections were counterstained with DAPI. Scale bars: 300 μm (E-H), 150 μm (I-N). (O-X) FISH for Wfs1 transcript (red) followed by double immunostaining for Gnrh1 (white) and nTubb3 (green) from mouse embryonic heads at E14.5 at the level of the nose. White dotted boxes indicate area shown at higher magnification in adjacent panels; single or combination of channel images are shown beside corresponding panels. Full white arrowheads in (P) and (U) indicate examples of GnRH neurons expressing Wfs1 mRNA. Full white arrows in (R) and (W) point at Wsf1 signal in Gnrh1+ neurons. Sections were counterstained with DAPI. Scale bars: 60 μm (O, P,T,U), 20 μm (Q-S, V-X). Abbreviations: VNO, vomeronasal organ; OE, olfactory epithelium. Representative images from three independent biological experiments are shown.

figures.figure_caption:
Figure 4. Wfs1b knockdown impairs GnRH3 neurons and reduces isl1a expression.

(A) Schematic representation of GnRH3 neurons development at 48hpf in ventral view. Abbreviations: AC: anterior commissure, OBs: olfactory bulbs, POA: preoptic area, Re: retina Hy: hypothalamus. (B-C) Confocal images of Tg (GnRH3: EGFP) embryos at 48hpf, ventral view in stdMO embryos (B) and wfs1bMOs (C). Scale bar: 100µm. Representative images from three independent biological experiments are shown. (D-E) Quantification of GnRH3 positive fibers in two separated districts: OBs and AC (D) and POA, Re and Hy (E) in wfs1bMOs and control embryos. Unpaired T-test with Welch correction. ** p<0.01; exact p values are provided in Appendix Table S1. Quantification was performed with ImageJ software on the same area (ROI) for each embryo. Results are expressed as means ± standard error of the mean (SEM), with n=33 stdMO control embryos and n=45 MOs embryos from three independent biological experiments. (F) Schematic representation of gnrh3 progenitors. (G-J) Whole mount in situ hybridization of pax6a at 14hpf and ngn1 at 24hpf in stdMO (G, I) and wfs1bMOs (H, J). Embryos were acquired in lateral view. Scale bar 500μm. Representative images of n = 24 embryos per condition from three independent biological experiments are shown. Abbreviations: Hb: hindbrain, sc: spinal cord, tel: telencephalon, die: diencephalon.
